title: Identify remaining European Red Spring source spans
changes: Record a source plan for the remaining 16 sampled Red Spring bytes: two original guarded switch tables and one eight-byte stack-copy source, with explicit pending implementation and platform checklists.
validation: Wine disassembly jqg8wh29 and 56f3ef_x identifies original guards and the eight-byte copy; both Wine servers drained.
Static source plan b39y_6rn authenticates original code, roots, helper and source ranges against the exact EUR ROM and E224 manifest; these spans account for all 16 remaining sample bytes.
limitations: The capture is address-only and does not establish executing PCs, all callers or complete ROM coverage; the plan does not publish or consume resources.
Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance comparison was performed.
